description: Shows a panel where the user picks a match for each address and sets the start, finish, time at each stop and distance unit. Takes each original address with its suggested matches; addresses without suggestions let the user search again in the panel. Missing start and finish appear as empty fields, and fields in routeSettings.ignoredFields are listed as not applied. Read-only: when the user clicks Optimize, the panel issues a single-use confirmation token for route creation.

notice.description: Town, country, street, or postcode differences between the candidates and the original address.

routeSettings.description: Initial route settings. The form collects start, end (or a return to the start), time at stop and distance unit, and adds empty start and finish fields when they are missing.

roundTrip.description: Whether the route ends back at the start. The user can choose an end location in the form instead.
